objective: Persist canonical acquisition-cost, premium, commission, and renewal facts in River CRM D1 without changing attribution, lead, quote, provider, fulfillment, contact, or telephony ownership.
persistenceRules: Canonical domain factories validate facts before write.
Rows are hydrated back through canonical domain factories.
Fact IDs are immutable table primary keys.
Optional domain values persist as SQL NULL.
Facts are append-only in this slice.
No update or delete API is introduced.
No production D1 migration is authorized by this implementation.
